episodes.title: Severance
episodes.summary: After the Shawshank warden kills himself in nearby Castle Rock, an anonymous prisoner is found in a block that the warden closed off 30 years ago. An anonymous call summons lawyer Henry Deaver to the town... but Henry has his own dark history with the small Maine town.

episodes.title: Habeas Corpus
episodes.summary: Henry tries to find out the name of his would-be client at Shawshank. Meanwhile, Molly remembers the past while trying to rejuvenate Castle Rock's present.

episodes.title: Local Color
episodes.summary: Henry meets Molly for the first time since their childhood, and his presence proves distracting when Molly tries to make a presentation for Castle Rock's rejuvenation on a cable access show.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.summary: Dennis makes the mistake of touching the Kid. Meanwhile, Henry discovers why Alan covered up for him when he was 11, and Molly tries to sell the Lacy house.

episodes.title: Harvest
episodes.summary: Once Henry gets the Kid released from prison, Molly offers the former prisoner temporary living arrangements. Meanwhile, a mysterious fire sweeps through Castle County and Alan has a bridge dedicated to him.

episodes.title: Filter
episodes.summary: Henry learns about the schisma and his adoptive father's connection to it. Meanwhile, the Kid sends Alan on a quest to find something he needs for his master plan.

episodes.title: The Queen
episodes.summary: Ruth is trapped in her own memories and the Kid takes advantage of her while she tries to stop him before it's too late.

episodes.title: Past Perfect
episodes.summary: A couple opens up a unique bed & breakfast in Castle Rock. Meanwhile, Henry learns that the B&B house holds an answer to the Kid's past, and suspects that the Kid is responsible for Alan's death at Ruth's hands.

episodes.title: Henry Deaver
episodes.summary: The Kid tells Molly where he came from, and his connection to Henry.

episodes.title: Romans
episodes.summary: Molly tells the Kid's story to Henry, who is then held for Odin's murder. Now Henry must decide whether he believes the Kid or not.

episodes.title: Let the River Run
episodes.summary: Annie Wilkes, fleeing a murder charge, ends up with her daughter Joy in Jerusalem's Lot. Ace Merrill threatens the Somali land developer who is "poaching" Ace's tenants, and Annie tries to get the drugs she needs from the hospital where she works as a temp.

episodes.title: New Jerusalem
episodes.summary: Pop looks for the missing Ace, suspecting that Abdi is involved. Annie takes Joy to the hospital, and Joy begins to question her mother's claims.

episodes.title: Ties that Bind
episodes.summary: Joy spends some time with her friends, and returns to find Annie in a frenzy. Abdi takes Pop to the hospital, and Ace talks with a real estate agent.

episodes.title: Restore Hope
episodes.summary: Nadia learns the truth about why Pop adopted her and Abdi. Ace builds his fellowship, and Joy moves in with Nadia.

episodes.title: The Laughing Place
episodes.summary: Annie and Joy's origins are explored as flashbacks reveals how Annie became the way she is in the present.

episodes.title: The Mother
episodes.summary: Rita comes to Castle Rock looking for her missing daughter, while the "new" Ace continues growing his flock.

episodes.title: The Word
episodes.summary: The founding of Jerusalem's Lot is revealed. In the present, Annie insists that she killed Rita on her own. Meanwhile, Pop begins to discover that Ace is up to something.

episodes.title: Dirty
episodes.summary: Ace gives Annie and Joy sanctuary at the Marsten House, and Annie gets a message from her dead mother. Meanwhile, Chris pays Nadia a visit.

episodes.title: Caveat Emptor
episodes.summary: Pop and a handful of unConverted hole up in the Emporium, and "Ace" wants what Pop has.

episodes.title: Clean
episodes.summary: Annie tries to find Joy at the Marsten House, while Nadia faces a difficult decision.
